units.source_text: 一个小时后，先生和我离开了市区，信步走在分不出是村还是镇的僻静所在。

en.t: About an hour later, Sensei and I left the city and wandered through a quiet place that could hardly be called either a village or a town.

units.source_text: 我从光叶石楠篱笆上掐了一片柔软的嫩叶，吹起了叶笛。

en.t: I pinched off a soft young leaf from a photinia hedge and began to blow a leaf whistle.

units.source_text: 我有个朋友是鹿儿岛人，我经常模仿他，不知不觉就学会了吹这种叶笛，已经吹得很好了。

en.t: I had a friend from Kagoshima, and by often imitating him I had learned almost without noticing how to play this kind of leaf whistle, and had become quite good at it.

units.source_text: 我得意地吹着，先生却好像没听见似的瞧着别处走着。

en.t: I played it proudly, but Sensei walked on looking elsewhere, as though he could not hear it.

units.source_text: 走了一会儿，在一处被郁郁葱葱的绿叶遮蔽的高坡前出现了一条小路。

en.t: After we had walked for a while, a narrow path appeared before a rise covered in lush green leaves.

units.source_text: 小路通向坡上的入口，入口的门柱上钉着的牌子上写着某某园，一看便知这里不是私人住宅。

en.t: The path led up to an entrance on the slope, and a sign nailed to the gatepost read So-and-so Garden, making it clear at once that this was not a private residence.

units.source_text: 先生望着坡上面的入口，对我说：“进去看看？”

en.t: Looking at the entrance above the slope, Sensei said to me, "Shall we go in and have a look?"
I answered at once, "It must be a nursery."

units.source_text: 我们沿着树丛拐过弯去，一直走到坡路最里面。

en.t: We followed the shrubs around a bend and went all the way to the very back of the sloping path.

units.source_text: 靠路左边有一户住家，敞开的拉门里空无一人，只有房檐下摆着一只大鱼缸，金鱼在里面游动着。

en.t: On the left side of the path stood a house; inside the open sliding doors there was no one, and only a large fishbowl sat under the eaves, with goldfish swimming in it.

units.source_text: “真静啊，咱们不打声招呼就进来，没关系吗？”

en.t: "It is so quiet. Is it all right for us to come in without calling out first?"

units.source_text: 我们又向园内走去，依然看不见人影。

en.t: We went farther into the garden, but still saw no sign of anyone.

units.source_text: 怒放的杜鹃花像燃烧的火焰一般。

en.t: The azaleas in full bloom looked like flames burning.

units.source_text: 先生指着其中一株高高的红褐色杜鹃花说：“这大概是雾岛。”

en.t: Pointing to one tall reddish-brown azalea among them, Sensei said, "This is probably a Kirishima."
